about_the_game:
Step into Fillet Fury, where every card draw can end in a flash of steel. Set against the backdrop of a ruthless Victorian-Frontier, players engage in high-stakes games that test both their nerves and their skills with a knife. But be warned, in Fillet Fury, the stakes are painfully high as players wager not their fortunes, but their fingers.

Experience an innovative blend of strategy and real-time action, where each decision can either bolster your position or cost you dearly. As you navigate through, you will need more than just luck to survive.

Gameplay:

Intense Mechanics: Bet your way through increasingly challenging opponents, where each round could escalate into a life-altering knife game.

Strategize: Adapt your strategy on the fly as every game unfolds differently based on your choices and your courage.

Wild West Atmosphere: From the visuals to the sound design, every element is crafted to plunge you into a merciless era of outlaws and sharpshooters.

Warning: This game is intended for mature audiences and features graphic violence, including simulated blood and gore, along with themes of self-harm inherent to its gameplay. Player discretion is advised.

content_descriptors.notes: Fillet Fury is intended for mature audiences and features intense scenarios involving graphic violence and simulated blood and gore, integral to its Wild West and high stakes gambling themes. The game also includes depictions of self-harm related to its narrative and gameplay mechanics. These elements are crafted to enhance the game's immersive experience but may not be suitable for all players. We advise players to consider their personal sensitivities to such content.

short_description: Manage custom decks in tense saloon showdowns, where every card draw could cost a finger as cards trigger a fast-paced knife game risking permanent finger loss. Every decision matters as tension rises each round. The last player with at least one finger intact wins.
